title: Polynomial extension of an algebraic dualizing complex
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], put $P=R[t]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and let $K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $R$-modules representing an algebraic dualizing complex in $D(R)$ [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing]. Form the $P$-complex $K_P^\bullet$ with $(K_P)^j=K^j\otimes_R P$ and differential $d_{K_P}^j=d_K^j\otimes1$, where tensor and change of rings are [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] on the one-object ringed site. Then $K_P^\bullet$ represents an algebraic dualizing complex over $P$. No local-ring or normalization hypothesis is imposed.
